decisions.Kwic: 單單提起箇無義味話頭，自最初一日立定脚頭，不得分毫移動，密密與之做向前去，

Decision.AttributionNote: Miscellaneous Records of Chan Master Tianmu Mingben (天目明本禪師雜錄), in Zhongfeng Mingben's summer-restriction instruction to the assembly at Shunxin Hermitage (結夏示順心庵眾). Zhongfeng Mingben is the exact author who tells the assembly to raise only a saying without the flavor of meaning and continue forward with it from the first day.
